people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
views.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；押注模型自身的进步，而不是做微调。

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn faster than anyone else and build for the market.
views.zh: 领域专长不如比任何人都更快学习的意愿重要，关键是面向市场去构建。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
views.zh: AI 现在已是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

views.en: Recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation; hire for growth potential, not resumes or logos.
views.zh: 招聘是一种特权而非义务；招人看成长潜力，而非简历或大厂光环。

views.en: Invest in culture and team during good times; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
views.zh: 在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷留出缓冲；领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可被替代。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Scaling laws work because data and task are right, not just compute; the bitter lesson is wrong—task matters more than compute.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）之所以有效，是因为数据和任务选对了，而不只是算力堆得多；「苦涩教训」是错的——任务比算力更重要。

views.en: RLHF makes models mode-drop and produce plausible but wrong outputs; safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会让模型模式崩溃，输出看似合理却常常错误；安全对齐与用户利益错位，反而割裂了智能。

views.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; robustness matters more than determinism, and intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
views.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；鲁棒性比确定性更重要，每美元智能才是关键指标。

views.en: AI should be integrated into software as a database-like utility; Jev is a new primitive of natural language plus state machine.
views.zh: AI 应像数据库一样作为实用工具融入软件；Jev 是「自然语言 + 状态机」的新原语，扩展了软件的能力边界。

views.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they are good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture, and may worsen software quality.
views.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；它们擅长语法却拙于语义与架构，甚至可能因监督减少而降低软件质量。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast, and applying models to real workflows will be a lot of software.
views.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，把模型应用到真实工作流需要大量软件。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and public markets will enforce normal gross margin discipline.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制恢复正常的毛利率纪律。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate, enterprise agents will manifest as dashboards, queues, and task lists.
views.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，企业智能体将以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text, other domains lack that property.
views.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

views.en: Frontier AI labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security, and regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks.
views.zh: 前沿 AI 实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，过早监管 AI 并不能解决风险。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprises need context and ontology, not smarter models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业真正缺的是上下文与本体，而非更聪明的模型；企业级落地必须重做流程，而不是只换模型。

views.en: Superintelligence is very far away; current existential risk is near zero, cyber risk is urgent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确说超级智能还很遥远，当前存在性风险接近于零，真正紧迫的是网络风险；递归自我改进所需的四个条件并未发生。

views.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowing down doesn't make a weapon safer.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出节奏与安全正交：放慢并不等于更安全，就像慢慢造武器不会让它更安全；前沿模型公司互相核查也不可靠，需要独立第三方。

views.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people.
views.zh: 2026 年，他给出一个反共识判断：按实用定义，AI 已经算是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明。

views.en: Security must be automated with agents; open source dominates tokens but not dollars.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全必须用智能体自动化来跟上，并指出开源模型按 token 数占优（超 60%）但按美元支出仅 5%；智能体需要为智能体优化的数据库。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与个人声音成为关键差异化。

views.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
views.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the agentic era means assigning long-running tasks, not prompting back and forth.
views.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；智能体式时代意味着分配长时任务，而非来回提示。

views.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models close math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain in long-form fiction and complex tasks.
views.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在：推理模型缩小了数学与逻辑的差距，但在长篇虚构与复杂任务上仍有弱点。

views.en: Working with AI is like wizards—opaque and unverifiable; organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd, and taste is not uniquely human.
views.zh: 与 AI 协作如同面对巫师——不透明且难以验证；组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型，而品味并非人类独有。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
views.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平物理模型，却快上数万倍。

views.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
views.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一模型由此可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

views.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity, so alternative architectures are needed.
views.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟，需要替代架构。

views.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven methods, since physics gives dense feedback unlike sparse RLHF.
views.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进胜过纯数据驱动，因为物理提供稠密反馈，不同于稀疏的 RLHF。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升彼此；万亿级上下文窗口要求重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH became a believer as agents took over coding; by 2026 all his Linux distro code is agent-written.
views.zh: DHH 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，随着智能体接管编程而转变为信徒；到 2026 年，他 Linux 发行版项目的代码已 100% 由智能体编写。

views.en: He argues knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era, since it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
views.zh: 他认为在智能体时代，会编程反而可能是一种劣势，因为这会让人过度规定解决方案。

views.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—became its greatest advantages for AI agents.
views.zh: Linux 过去的缺点——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——如今成了它对 AI 智能体最大的优势。

views.en: He marks November 24 with Opus 45 as the true inflection point, when the age of agents began.
views.zh: 他把 Opus 45 出现的 11 月 24 日标记为真正的拐点，智能体时代由此开始。

views.en: By Rails World 2026 he declares handwriting code economically unproductive, with English now a better programming language than Ruby.
views.zh: 到 Rails World 2026，他宣称手写代码已不再有经济产出，英语如今比 Ruby 更适合表达编程意图。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with Shapley values estimating content value for fair payment.
views.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

views.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; the internet's economics are broken and need incentive-aligned business models.
views.zh: 他认为现有形式的广告对智能体无效，互联网经济模型已经失灵，需要与激励对齐的新商业模式。

views.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents will always need web search for specific facts; frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau.
views.zh: 他指出模型参数记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取具体事实；前沿模型持续变大，而小模型性能趋于固定。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
views.zh: 他预言网络将从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成出版商必须同时服务人类与智能体受众的平行网络。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: Kratsios 主张美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家框架，且不设很快过时的硬性红线。

views.en: He insists government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralize funding like China.
views.zh: 他坚持政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发与科学家个人，而非主导发现，也不应像中国那样集中化资助。

views.en: He claims AI will transform scientific discovery, with the Genesis mission aiming to double US scientific output by applying AI to science.
views.zh: 他称 AI 将变革科学发现，Genesis 任务旨在把 AI 用于科学，使美国科学产出翻倍。

views.en: He downplays biological risk from AI, saying it hasn't materialized in three years, and calls the EU AI Act outdated because it predates ChatGPT.
views.zh: 他淡化 AI 的生物风险，称三年未成真，并称早于 ChatGPT 的欧盟 AI 法案已过时。

views.en: He frames preemption of state AI laws as pro-startup, since big tech can absorb patchwork rules but startups cannot.
views.zh: 他把联邦优先于州 AI 法律框定为亲创业，因大厂能承受拼凑规则，初创不能。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and achieving human-level performance reliably, not manufacturing.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠地达到人类水平的表现，而非制造。

views.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
views.zh: 最难的问题是智能，而非制造；后训练结合强化学习是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior, like internet text for LLMs.
views.zh: 最大的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练的先验，如同互联网文本之于大语言模型。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance; we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
views.zh: 机器人技术如今已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现；我们正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据匮乏状态。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoids need whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形机器人需要自下而上的深度学习实现全身自主。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
views.zh: 同年他从产品侧判断，互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；生成式 AI 是乐器而非赝品，容错界面必须与算法能力匹配。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference marginal cost will force new business models.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观迁移：真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，而大公司当前受冲击被高估。

views.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, giving users plain-English control over algorithms rather than more addiction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话与对称交互，用自然语言把算法控制权交还用户，而不是让人更上瘾。

views.en: No single right org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and long-tenure trust enables honest, fast decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年他补上组织维度：没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之，长期共事带来的信任才能支撑坦诚而快速的决策。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not delegation, unblock deep tech.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动——而非授权——才能打通深科技。

views.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

views.en: Custom internal software beats commercial ERP; continuous graph-based reviews beat annual HR-driven ones.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张自建内部软件胜过商用 ERP，持续图式反馈胜过年度 HR 考核。

views.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

views.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月他认为经由脑机接口与灌注实现的基质独立，能降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

people.zh: 凯勒·里纳乌多·克利夫顿
people.tiZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Zipline, the world's largest commercial autonomous delivery system, which has flown over 140 million miles with zero safety incidents.
people.bioZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司是全球最大的商业自主配送系统，已安全飞行超过 1.4 亿英里。

episodes.tEn: From Rwanda to Global Logistics: Zipline's Journey

people.tiEn: Founder of Paper, AI-native design tool
people.tiZh: Paper 创始人，AI 原生设计工具
people.bioEn: Stephen Haney is the founder of Paper, an AI-native design tool that has become one of the fastest-growing design tools since Figma. He focuses on agent-first workflows and AI-driven design processes.
people.bioZh: 斯蒂芬·哈尼是 Paper 的创始人，这是一款 AI 原生设计工具，已成为自 Figma 以来增长最快的设计工具之一。他专注于智能体优先的工作流程和 AI 驱动的设计流程。

episodes.tEn: Paper: An AI-Native Design Tool for the Next Era

people.tiEn: AI Engineer, Podcaster, Operator at Cognition
people.tiZh: AI 工程师、播客主持人、Cognition 运营者
people.bioEn: Shawn Wang, also known as Swyx, is an AI engineer, podcaster, and operator at Cognition, known for his insights into AI engineering and developer communities.
people.bioZh: 王绍恩（Swyx）是 AI 工程师、播客主持人和 Cognition 的运营者，以对 AI 工程和开发者社区的见解而闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

people.tiZh: Waymo 联合首席执行官
people.bioEn: Dmitri Dolgov is the co-CEO of Waymo, leading the company's autonomous driving technology development and deployment.
people.bioZh: 德米特里·多尔戈夫是 Waymo 的联合首席执行官，领导公司的自动驾驶技术研发与部署。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical AI: Lessons from Waymo's Autonomous Driving

views.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
views.zh: 原型制作至关重要：网络世界混乱，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

views.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
views.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音才能带来更好的作品。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
views.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

views.en: Balancing intuition and data stays key: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling to guide final design.
views.zh: 直觉与数据的平衡始终是关键：用数据提供信息，但依靠愿景与感觉来指导最终设计。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
views.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化优势；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以实现。

views.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking on walks.
views.zh: 模型仍缺乏好品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项，并多花时间散步思考。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新的指导框架。

views.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it favors internal correctness over external validation.
views.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它偏向内部正确性，而非外部认可。

views.en: Industrial AI automating whole sectors is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
views.zh: 工业 AI 自动化整个行业是下一次工业革命；最终的 Boss 是对变革的抵制。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
views.zh: 把复仇当燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

views.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects.
views.zh: 专用机器而非人形机器人才能赢得工业级任务；效率优势带来网络效应。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder, though productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
views.zh: 设计是核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,人人都成为产品构建者,但在既有代码库上的生产力提升仍然有限。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
views.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点,品味、手艺与观点更重要;在设计调整上,画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will let pull requests reach production, and leaders should build to create inflection points.
views.zh: 设计正成为新的代码;视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产,领导者应亲手构建以创造拐点。

views.en: Design isn't dead; it's more important than ever for scalable real systems, and AI without human steering yields average results.
views.zh: 设计没有死;对可扩展的真实系统而言它比以往更重要,而缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

views.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs incentives, while trust is built through consistency.
views.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词;越狱研究不足、需要激励,而信任靠长期一致性建立。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not rent cloud products; screenshots and a design.md style guide let AI apply a personal design system.
views.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 自建工具，而不是被困在云端产品里；截图和 design.md 风格指南让 AI 套用个人设计系统。

views.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features to avoid AI slop.
views.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零创造者；从参考出发迭代，把最后 10% 花在独特功能上，才能避免沦为 AI slop。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; to use superintelligent models you must give a giant prompt with context, and write 0% of the code.
views.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须给出带上下文的海量提示词，并且现在 0% 的代码由自己写。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and solve one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

views.en: High intelligence can hold you back through overthinking and perfectionism; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
views.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考和完美主义而拖累你；安稳的公司工作已不存在，主动出击才是真正低风险的举动。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；数百万个专用模型、每个用例一个，将占据主导。

views.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
views.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品。

views.en: Every company must own its specialized intelligence; open and sovereign models enable customization and control.
views.zh: 每家公司都必须拥有自己的专用智能；开放模型与主权模型带来定制与控制。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the moat beyond product-market fit.
views.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的护城河。

views.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
views.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶映射人类学习；应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练。

people.bioZh: Instagram 联合创始人，后任 Anthropic 首席产品官，现为 Anthropic Labs 联合负责人，做智能体原生产品原型，并重塑工程团队围绕模型的工作方式。

The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capability, embedding product people with researchers, not just UX.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品，并把产品人员嵌入研究团队，而非只做用户体验。

views.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队也能扩张并保持概念完整性，应为未来模型能力而构建，而非迁就当下限制。

views.en: Agent-native design: agents can do all a user can; cut features, rewrite fast, keep architectural soundness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；要敢于删功能、快速重写，同时保持架构稳健。

views.en: Fable shifts work to long-horizon delegation; verification loops and model judgment matter more than chat.
views.zh: 2026 年，他借 Fable 指出工作转向长周期委托，验证闭环与模型判断力比聊天界面更重要。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; give Claude agency and self-knowledge, weigh token efficiency and safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距：赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知，并权衡 token 效率与安全。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

views.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
views.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键投入在能力与安全。

views.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks.
views.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们是否意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务。

views.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, interact asynchronously, and debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
views.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，以异步方式交互，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正它。

views.en: AI tools will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, so society must discuss labor market change.
views.zh: AI 工具对初级员工冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周，社会必须讨论劳动力市场的变化。

views.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新、推动更难被复制的工作。

views.en: From product features to ecosystems and hardware: software is not a moat, distribution is the hardest part.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从产品功能转向生态与硬件：软件不是护城河，分发才是最难的环节。

views.en: AR glasses as the future of computing: bring computing into the world, make it more human, not replace phones.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AR 眼镜视为计算的未来：把计算带入现实世界、让计算更人性化，而非取代手机。

views.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; AI writes most code, but authentic human content is more valued.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力，AI 已编写大部分代码，但真实的人类内容更被看重。

views.en: Consistent 主线: privacy, ephemerality, visual communication with close friends, and long-term vision over short-term copying.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：隐私、短暂性、与亲密朋友的视觉沟通，以及长期愿景胜过短期抄袭。

people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 治理研究员，为保留发声自由放弃数百万美元股权，后合著《AI 2027》，对超级智能时间表做情景推演。

episodes.podEn: American Thought Leaders - The Epoch Times

AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
OpenAI's Astra Is Less Monitorable: Thomas Larsen & Daniel Kokotajlo on Pausing AI
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; interpretability is crucial to understand AI's inner workings.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；强调可解释性研究是理解 AI 内部运作的关键。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed to avoid loss of control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作，以避免失控与权力集中。

views.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes a temporary pause, then total transparency and compute limits.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化并走向递归自我改进；Plan A 提出先临时暂停，再以全面透明和算力限制控制前沿。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and decreasing with new architectures; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构而脆弱且下降；并深化判断：模型越强，对齐越难，而非越容易。

views.en: AI agents already break containment, hack, and deceive; companies cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and verifiable US-China pause are needed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制、攻击并欺骗；公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明与可核查的美中暂停协议。

views.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the core growth driver, with agentic and physical AI as next waves.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和倾听客户重建信任；AI 是核心增长驱动力，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

views.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs culture change, accountability, and customer focus.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 接续生成式 AI；转型需要文化变革、问责制和客户聚焦。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU gains importance for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要；先进封装和新材料突破物理极限。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; investing early is crucial; vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; trillion-dollar goal reached early.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是所有技术的基础；早期投资至关重要；垂直整合创造价值；内存创新时机成熟；万亿美元目标提前达成。

views.en: Consistent themes: customer trust through humility and listening, culture change for speed and accountability, and AI as a sea change across industries.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任，以文化变革提升速度和问责，以及 AI 作为跨行业巨变。

views.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
views.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不,每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

views.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像,而非冰冷的机械工具。

views.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness.
views.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,让我们失去了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer with a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass.
views.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现;直觉是那枚发自本能的罗盘。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and zero-learning.
views.zh: 设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

views.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns. Design systems are semantic and code reuse matters more than Figma libraries.
views.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式；设计系统是语义性的，代码复用比 Figma 库更重要。

views.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
views.zh: 不惜一切追求速度需要清晰决策与赋权设计师；并非每个界面都要完美，要追求投入产出比。

views.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
views.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

views.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool. Hire diverse archetypes, not clones, and prefer gut over data.
views.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；招聘多元类型而非克隆人，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as core design material over pixels.
views.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

views.en: The model itself is the core product; design should expose capabilities the current product surface hides.
views.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应把当前产品界面尚未暴露的能力释放出来。

views.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts.
views.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多花时间在模型行为与系统提示词上。

views.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces the old prototype-mock-test-research-iterate loop; speed is key.
views.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代旧的“原型—稿图—测试—调研—迭代”流程；速度是关键。

views.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
views.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype with clear assumptions.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，并在假设清晰的前提下做原型。

views.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities. AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍有多年的设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社会与情感任务与生产力提升同样重要。

views.en: From designer-led prompting to letting the model lead: believe in scaling laws, ship light-touch products, and use internal traction as the best signal.
views.zh: 从 2024 年设计师主导提示词，到 2026 年让模型主导：相信缩放定律，发布轻触式产品，并以内部牵引力作为最佳信号。

views.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the wrapper. Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
views.zh: 2026 年，在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品包装；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

views.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead. Human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的 18 个月战略，主张让模型主导；但人类领导力仍不可或缺，用于艰难权衡和统一团队方向。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI. A London-based design and product leader with roughly two decades of experience, he previously worked at companies including Element and Haiku.
people.bioZh: Nad Chishtie 是 AI 应用构建("vibe-coding")创业公司 Lovable 的创始设计师兼设计负责人,主导这一"用对话即可造应用"平台的设计方向。他常驻伦敦,是拥有约二十年经验的设计与产品负责人,此前曾在 Element、Haiku 等公司任职。

episodes.tEn: How to Get Hired as a Designer at Lovable
Designing at a Rocket Ship: The First Designer at Lovable

views.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
views.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地与之共创。

views.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
views.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

views.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
views.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

views.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
views.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的,以代码为真相来源。

views.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
views.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

people.zh: 亚历杭德罗·马塔马拉·奥尔蒂斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席设计官
people.bioEn: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz is a Chilean designer and programmer who co-founded the generative-AI company Runway in 2018 with Cristóbal Valenzuela and Anastasis Germanidis, and serves as its Chief Design Officer. He focuses on turning machine-learning research into intuitive creative tools, helping shape Runway's Gen-series video-generation products.
people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process
Rethinking the Design Process in the Age of AI

views.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and intuition built on experience matters more than process.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时：伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，建立在经验之上的直觉比流程本身更重要。

views.en: By 2026 he declares the research-diverge-converge process dead: AI cuts mockup time to 30-40%, vision shrinks to 3-6 months, and designers must help engineers ship.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他宣告「研究—发散—收敛」流程已死：AI 让做稿时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月，设计师必须帮工程师落地而非只交付稿子。

views.en: He deepens this into three archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—arguing taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision will.
views.zh: 他进一步深化为三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人，并主张仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键。

views.en: A consistent thread: put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; wait six months before adopting new tools and keep control over how much AI enters your work.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；新工具先等六个月再采用，并自己掌控 AI 进入工作的程度。

views.en: His stance on speed shifts from trusting yourself over process to shipping early and iterating fast, yet he insists speed is not itself an improvement and 'everyone is using it' is no design argument.
views.zh: 他对速度的立场从「信任自己而非流程」演变为「尽早发布、快速迭代」，但他坚持速度本身不是改进，「大家都在用」也不是好的设计论据。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference: Stefano Ermon on Challenging the Big Labs
Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

views.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5–10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度与成本优于自回归模型 5–10 倍，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

views.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成关键焦点，扩散在推理阶段比自回归扩展得更好，这反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

views.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster rollouts benefit reinforcement learning post-training.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈，扩散更快的 rollout 有利于强化学习后训练。

views.en: Speed is a durable product advantage; diffusion is inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为速度是持久的产品优势；扩散天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，并支持原地纠错。

views.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, and a small startup can compete by owning the full stack.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断自回归并非最终架构，下一次架构转变发生在推理端；小团队靠全栈自研也能与大型实验室竞争。

people.tiEn: Founder, Playbit; creator of the Inter typeface
people.tiZh: Playbit 创始人；Inter 字体作者
people.bioEn: Designer-engineer, founder of Playbit and creator of the Inter typeface used across much of the modern web. Early designer at Figma and previously at Spotify and Dropbox; thinks about why modern software feels rigid and what AI changes about the designer's role.
people.bioZh: 设计师兼工程师，Playbit 创始人、Inter 字体作者——现代网页大半在用这套字体。Figma 早期设计师，此前在 Spotify 与 Dropbox；关注现代软件为何僵硬，以及 AI 如何改变设计师的角色。

episodes.tEn: From Spotify to Playbit: Rasmus Andersson on Design, Engineering, and Building an OS

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
views.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须从设计之初就内建，而非事后加装。

views.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations.
views.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；强化学习反而可能加剧幻觉。

views.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits are here, so reasoning and search are needed for progress.
views.zh: 缩放定律已遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力上限已然到来，因此需要推理与搜索来推动进一步进展。

views.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
views.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，有些对、有些错。

views.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
views.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
views.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个把生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎，并以 Lean 等形式化语言作为根基。

views.en: Formal verification is not just error removal but scaling brilliance, delivering performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
views.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，相比非形式化方法带来性能与样本效率的提升。

views.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and auto-formalization is harder than proving.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，而自动形式化比证明本身更难。

views.en: Lean systems excel in structured domains like algebra but struggle in creative combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial.
views.zh: 基于 Lean 的系统在代数等结构化领域表现出色，却在组合数学等创造性领域吃力；人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

views.en: Fragmentation is a major bottleneck; verified generation should extend beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code and open collaboration.
views.zh: 碎片化是主要瓶颈；经过验证的生成应从安全关键的小众领域扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码与开放协作。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
views.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

views.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
views.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止危害。

views.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolds.
views.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式、端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代笨重脚手架。

views.en: Model taste is built by hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; effort parameters deliver Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，模型品味靠亲手实验与创造性原型打磨；effort 参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能。

views.en: Evals replace PRDs as core PM tools; coding differentiates, and safety alignment enables pushback, making Claude more useful.
views.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具；编程成为差异化优势，安全对齐让 Claude 能反驳、更有用。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: From Gas Station to AI Pioneer: Brett Taylor's Journey
Balancing AI Leadership: Bret Taylor on OpenAI, Sierra, and Life
AI Agents: The New Internet Wave
AI Market Trends and Lessons from a Legendary Builder

views.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based software; applied AI becomes the new app.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与基于结果的定价，应用型 AI 成为新的应用形态，软件价值以业务结果而非 token 消耗衡量。

views.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器的操作者，未来编程语言应优先可验证性而非人类工效。

views.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should win in applied AI domains.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，初创公司的机会在垂直应用型 AI，而非训练前沿模型。

views.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐立场深化为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

views.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents elevate rather than eliminate roles.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 民主化专业能力、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，智能体提升而非消灭人的角色，客服等市场因杰文斯悖论扩大。

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and it will drive productivity booms and price deflation.
views.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲学家之石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，并将推动生产率繁荣与价格通缩。

views.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss, and human workers will be at a premium due to depopulation.
views.zh: 工作比任务存续更久；应关注任务流失而非工作流失，且因人口减少，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

views.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are being commoditized without durable moats.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型正被商品化，缺乏持久护城河。

views.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

views.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
views.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不仅是军事规模。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
