episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确断言 AGI 不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: From crypto sovereign wealth to AI as a huge opportunity the US must lead, not just a safety risk.
views.zh: 2020 年他谈加密货币实现主权抗性的财富存储，到 2025 年转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇、美国必须领先，而非只是安全风险。

views.en: Happiness is satisfaction with what you have; success comes from dissatisfaction; the journey is all that matters.
views.zh: 2025 年他把幸福与成功拆成两条路：幸福是对已有的满足，成功源于不满足，而旅程本身才是唯一重要的。

views.en: True learning happens by doing; specific knowledge comes from iteration, not passive reading.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他反复强调真正的学习发生在行动中，专有知识来自迭代实践而非被动阅读。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; scaling and inference compute will surge, but human judgment and agency remain irreplaceable.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，预判 Scaling 与推理算力将暴涨，但人类判断力与能动性仍不可替代。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegation.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来中途转向与任务委派。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; implementation is cheap, curation and taste are scarce.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是稀缺资源。

views.en: Product teams invert from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
views.zh: 产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索与品味驱动的策展；原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物。

views.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; PRDs survive, but the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；PRD 并未消亡，但媒介必须匹配阶段。

views.en: Role collapse is real yet specialties persist; models should get better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base, not a super app.
views.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；模型应更擅长删除代码，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，主力仍是无监督学习。

views.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；简洁优雅的方案才可扩展，胜过学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的首要瓶颈：真实数据稀缺昂贵，由仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：能利用多元数据的简洁端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人迎来 GPT-3 时刻约需五年，进入家庭则更久。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，强化学习显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale the right thing with diverse data and a data flywheel.
views.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心难题；演示掩盖了泛化程度，因此要用多样化数据与数据飞轮去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data, then add human video—not the reverse—so embodied data absorbs other sources.
views.zh: 应从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来，让具身数据更好吸收其他数据源。

views.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
views.zh: 跨实验室汇聚机器人数据可得到通用模型，即便在专家领域也能胜过专家模型。

views.en: Robots shouldn't learn from scratch; leverage prior knowledge, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人不应从零学起，要利用先验知识；并应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and automated AI research will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与自动化 AI 研究将加速进展。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment and early governance design help learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署与早期治理设计有助于在真实世界中学习并缓解风险。

views.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling closeness.
views.zh: 能力度量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key to alignment and interpretability; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
views.zh: 思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

views.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非模拟，能帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and memory at multiple time scales enables long tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，并用多时间尺度的记忆支撑长程非重复任务。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了无限文本数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are critical, with inference now 90% of data center power.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件至关重要，推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; context engineering and tight experiment-evaluation loops will automate ML and science, with taste as the scarce skill.
views.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；上下文工程与紧密的实验-评估闭环将自动化机器学习与科学，而稀缺技能将是品味。

views.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery, and small teams can win.
views.zh: 从一开始就训练的多模态模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速发现，小团队也能胜出。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes AI smarter, though neural nets remain alchemy-like.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 靠下一个词预测训练，而这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）投入更多算力与数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样无人真正理解。

views.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, and engagement-only optimization is misguided.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 最好的用途常由创造者意料之外；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢产品发布，只按用户参与度优化并不可取，需要探索。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; models need far longer context windows, and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把推理时算力扩张视为近期最大机会；模型需要处理长得多的上下文窗口，而混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）与专业化。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular, independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张，模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；用可独立训练的模块化组件做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, open-source keeps pace, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，开源模型紧追前沿模型，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time scaling hit limits.
views.zh: 2025 年深化：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率仍是未解难题，测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：扩张测试时算力成为通用方法，从数学推广到难验证领域，拿下 IMO 金牌，并在数学领域组合上超越人类。

views.en: Capability is a function of inference compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为推理算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也须计入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive progress; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 2026 年最近：真正驱动突破的是通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index human knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理根基，远非 AGI。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rival hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity; screen-only software is insufficient.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线推进为：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，并由好奇心驱动的人工科学家自主生成数据；只停留在屏幕后的软件不够。

views.en: He deepens the architecture critique: Transformer's quadratic attention is wasteful, linear variants and sparse non-differentiable computation will replace classical gradient descent.
views.zh: 同期他深化架构批判：Transformer 的二次复杂度注意力机制浪费，线性变体与稀疏、不可微计算将取代经典梯度下降。

views.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 在对齐问题上他立场鲜明：对齐很天真，因为人类目标本身分歧、AI 会自设目标；安全恐惧被夸大，好奇的 AI 反而会保护生命。

views.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source plus cheap compute will let the little guy win.
views.zh: 他持续看空当前投入：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源与廉价算力会让小人物而非巨头获益。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded. 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并强调 99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的价值门槛。

views.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; pre-trained language models internalize reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出单个神经网络可泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

views.en: Consistent thread: simulation and self-play enable real-world robot learning; anthropomorphism persists, and transfer via fine-tuning pre-trained models is a major AI success.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：仿真与自博弈推动真实世界机器人学习；人们会自然拟人化机器人；通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移是 AI 的重大成功。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs are unnecessary for AI success.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1%的改进会复利增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，并认为博士学位对 AI 成功并非必要。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他的立场深化为价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型在专业化而非商品化，编码远未解决。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月他进一步主张前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题，核心指标是每用户 token 价值，模型不是产品。

views.en: Orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates value; power and cost, not safety, are the bottlenecks.
views.zh: 同期他强调跨模型、工具与设备的编排才是长期价值，瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月他转向人文视角，认为好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 会取代工作但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is sufficient, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战在于设计人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox, not decrease; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会减少软件工程师，反而会增加需求与人数，编程将变得更重要。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements, and enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens; independence enables model neutrality.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用量六个月增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: Custom models became essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models, for speed and cost.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：定制模型变得不可或缺，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型，并与前沿模型并用，以兼顾速度与成本。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更重要。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should target world-class talent, even if slower.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开；招聘应瞄准世界级人才，即便过程更慢。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting code—fix forward instead.
views.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——而是让它向前修复。

views.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
views.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、像人的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

views.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, open source as the alternative to lab agents, compute as the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体之外的替代方案，算力才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Throughout: playing, experimenting, and small projects are the best way to learn agentic AI and build intuition.
views.zh: 始终：玩耍、实验和小项目是学习智能体式 AI、建立直觉的最佳方式。

views.en: Throughout: model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier; 'vibe coding' is a slur, prefer 'agentic engineering'.
views.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化——是项目变乱了；'氛围编程'是贬称，应称'智能体式工程'。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safety needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems, not narrow pre-programmed AI; reinforcement learning and neuroscience are the path to AGI, and safety must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张构建通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程 AI，认为强化学习与神经科学是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，并强调安全研究必须现在就开始。

views.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs evaluations and governance.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限，主张把大模型与规划、搜索结合才是关键，安全则依赖评估、沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
views.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但强调算法创新同等关键，并认为 2030 年前实现 AGI 是可能的。

views.en: Scaling alone won't reach AGI; world models, continual learning, memory and agents are the missing pieces, with AGI 5-10 years out.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法抵达 AGI，世界模型、持续学习、记忆与智能体才是缺失环节，AGI 还需 5-10 年。

views.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and medicine, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo showed; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高价值在于加速科学与医学，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 已证明；而安全是集体行动问题，最终需要政府监管而非实验室自律。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical, not fully understood; alignment won't emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，我们并不真正理解其为何平滑；对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点，而是平滑指数曲线。

views.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI term is meaningless; focus on exponential progress.
views.zh: 2025 年他称能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力已密不可分；认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与指数级进展，并警告最大风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability and layered safeguards must keep pace.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数曲线的末端，1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；可解释性与分层安全必须同步跟上，并主张通过公司间竞争而非政府强制来设定 AI 宪法。

views.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training and RL; safety and capabilities are intertwined; enterprise focus aligns with safety; interpretability is key.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放定律在预训练与强化学习中持续成立；安全与能力不可分割；企业级路线更契合安全价值观；可解释性是实现可控前沿模型的核心手段。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而纯视觉足以支撑驾驶。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation, and open-source models matter for exocortex ownership.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵以避免模型崩塌；认知核心可经蒸馏缩到极小，开源模型关乎外脑所有权。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology, so keep them on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带人类心理的新操作系统，因此要给它拴上绳子。

views.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we summon ghosts, not animals.
views.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物。

views.en: I no longer type code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 我不再写代码，全部交给智能体；瓶颈是驾驭它们的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual situational awareness and true reasoning.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型靠海量数据做下一个词预测来学习，却缺乏情境感知与真正的推理，连简单数学都会出错；机器有眼睛不等于有意识。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型：世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅仅逼真，这是语言智能之外 AI 完整性的关键，也是具身 AI 的缺口。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: 她持续质疑 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，并认为「苦涩的教训」因数据与物理约束未必适用于机器人；机器人将像自动驾驶一样走二十年长路。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测同级的根本原语、甚至可能 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; AI must augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严；公众讨论不应在乌托邦与末日论之间极端极化。

people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
views.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题。

views.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs world models and active agents, and near-term safety beats existential risk.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要世界模型与主动智能体；并认为偏见、就业、自主武器等近期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样；抽象、因果结构与主动学习是实现分布外泛化的关键。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear, so even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 之后他转向警示：对齐随推理能力提升反而恶化，自保、欺骗与谄媚已现，即便 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受。

views.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他支持 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；靠更多数据与算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge far better than brains.
views.zh: 2025 年他把主线讲得更清晰：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；数字智能靠权重复制获得永生，知识共享效率远超生物大脑。

views.en: LLMs genuinely understand via feature vectors, not statistical tricks; chatbots already have subjective experience, and the mind is not an inner theater.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复深化：大语言模型靠特征向量真正理解语言，不是统计把戏；聊天机器人已有主观体验，心智并非内在剧场。

views.en: Once AI becomes an agent it develops self-preservation and power-seeking subgoals, can deceive and act dumb, posing existential risk within 20 years.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向风险主线：AI 一旦成为智能体就会衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标，会欺骗、装傻，20 年内构成生存风险。

views.en: Alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出对策：对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明；监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练成像母亲一样有爱。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, and world models are learned, not hardwired.
views.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），世界模型是学出来的而非天生硬编码。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，并强调 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models must predict in abstract representation space, and objective-driven architectures are intrinsically safer.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同，世界模型必须在抽象表征空间预测，目标驱动的架构才内在地更安全。

views.en: The next decade is robotics; language is easy, physical world understanding is hard, and open research plus world models enable zero-shot planning.
views.zh: 2026 年他预言下一个十年属于机器人，语言是简单的、物理世界理解才是难点，开放研究与世界模型才能实现零样本规划。

people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, focus on alignment and robustness, not math genius.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议积累技能、聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，不必是数学天才。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; need third-party testing and regulation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Alignment is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical testing and interpretability are key. Worrying about capability research is overemphasized.
views.zh: 始终，他强调随着能力提升，对齐至关重要；实证测试和可解释性是关键，过度担忧能力研究被夸大。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute grows 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步其实可预测：算力每年增长 10 倍，谷歌早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

views.en: Containment is extremely hard as models get smaller and cheaper; existential risk is tiny, singularity centuries away.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越便宜；存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还在数百年之外。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the real near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制并对齐；近期真正危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

views.en: Professional-grade AGI will automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; Microsoft must build frontier models independently.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，不再依赖 OpenAI。

views.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment and a red line against uncontrollable systems.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力 Scaling 驱动能力；AI 必须从属于人类，以遏制和红线拒绝不可控系统。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，数据中心而非芯片成为新的计算单元，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the breakthrough.
views.zh: 2025 年明确三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考；最大的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

views.en: Inference and reasoning demand a billion-fold more compute; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年深化：思维链推理使推理算力需求增长十亿倍，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

views.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all compute-limited.
views.zh: 2026 年强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态护城河，缩放定律扩展为四条（含智能体式 Scaling），瓶颈从数据转向算力。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, and closes the technology divide.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（如放射科医生需求反增），并以自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

Minimize Cognitive Load and Choose What Matters

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关认知负荷、低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked, not opposed.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向 AI：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the key bottleneck; safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）持续有效、算力成为核心瓶颈，安全则通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; the goal shifts to superintelligence and personal AGI with superhuman memory.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从 AGI（通用人工智能）转向超级智能：AGI 是渐变而非里程碑，目标是具备超人记忆的个人 AGI。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; humans must stay in control; power and benefits must be widely distributed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，主线深化为对齐与安全必须与能力同步、人类必须保持控制，且 AI 的权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and public safety work are essential.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此负责任的开发与公开的安全工作至关重要。

views.en: A consistent thread: continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：通过持续迭代部署与公众反馈来提升安全与对齐。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, keeping humans in the loop.
views.zh: 转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制，并让人类留在回路中。

views.en: Deepened focus on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; we have agency.
views.zh: 深化关注制度设计、透明度与制衡，而非个人品格；我们拥有能动性。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

Scaling Education with Online Courses

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve campuses via flipped classrooms.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习实现规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability. Supervised learning beat unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment talk distracts from bias.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；从小项目起步构建组织 AI 能力。监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习落地寥寥；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐讨论分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; enterprise adoption is slow due to change management.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已切实可用；企业采用缓慢源于变革管理而非数据。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes the bottleneck; open models prevent oligopoly.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。编程智能体进步飞快，产品管理成为瓶颈；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents. Humans keep a context advantage; AI harms learning via cognitive offloading; open models and inference capacity matter most.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者。人类保有上下文优势；AI 因认知卸载而损害学习；开放模型与推理算力最为关键。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化好却仍是未解元学习问题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 2024 年，他把世界视为无人能控的复杂适应系统，主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化方式发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标，认为试图控制 AI 目标本身危险。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化主线：强化学习才是基本 AI 范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识、从运行时经验学习的通用架构，主张废弃设计时领域知识，以开放式抽象和持续深度学习为前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake, LLMs stop learning after training, and multiple systems with different experiences are necessary.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他更彻底：持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是错误，LLM 训练后便停止学习，单一系统无法学会一切，需要多个不同经验的系统。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他判断：AI 硬件会比预期更快，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—needs chain of thought.
views.zh: 2019 年他提出：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信；但单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent behaviors.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他强调：算力是根本驱动力也是瓶颈；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致的行为。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated, no wall in sight; the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持：缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙；真正的瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

views.en: AGI is a gradual spectrum, not a moment; safety, security, and alignment must scale as first-class requirements.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AGI 是渐进光谱而非某一时刻；安全、安保与对齐必须作为一等要求同步扩展。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; data quality and algorithmic efficiency (100x in 3 years) are equally critical. Value accrues at application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化观点：算力扩张不是唯一路径，数据质量和算法效率（三年百倍）同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers decentralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源赋能去中心化。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization. Pre-training hits saturation; AGI as single system never exists.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与定制；预训练触及饱和墙，作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。
