views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理思考推动工程突破。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not just superintelligence.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全重心放在第三方监管与坚持真理上，认为让 AI 说谎比超级智能本身更危险。

views.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and neurological damage first, then enables human-AI symbiosis as AI surpasses humans.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先解决神经损伤与带宽瓶颈，再实现人机共生以应对 AI 超越人类。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能数年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的毁灭风险估计。

views.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to orbit; abundance makes money irrelevant by 2036.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力撞上地球电力墙，数据中心将迁往轨道，而丰裕时代到 2036 年会让金钱失去意义。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling still works; reasoning models give more gains per compute, with post-training RL and synthetic data driving recent progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律依然有效，但强调推理模型每单位算力收益更高；近期进展主要来自后训练中的强化学习与合成数据。

views.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，指出预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓源于蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities lag text; models process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, a key area for improvement.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出多模态能力落后于文本，模型仍像小图块一样顺序处理输入，这是关键改进方向。

views.en: Generalization remains the key challenge: models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：泛化仍是核心挑战，模型需穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类能从少量样本泛化。

views.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; RL generalizes with jagged edges, requiring careful oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为，结合强化学习与工具的推理能解决难题但需海量数据；强化学习泛化有锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; validation/test discipline; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
views.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调验证集与测试集的纪律；并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification-following; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规格；AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four safety categories; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全分四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能借智能体实现自动化研究。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security; first breach may drive AI insurance.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步聚焦 AI 安全攻防：AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞；自动化红队已能超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入存在致命三要素；企业需要可配置的安全模型；首次重大公开提示注入事件可能推动 AI 保险普及。

views.en: Consistent thread: empirical rigor, skepticism of architecture hype, and emphasis on data, Scaling, and explicit safety effort over automatic guarantees.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：经验主义的严谨、对架构炒作的怀疑，以及强调数据、Scaling（规模扩张）与显式安全努力，而非依赖自动保证。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“入职”问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding is the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体的瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute becomes the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级而非停滞，Transformer 足以通向 AGI，推理算力将成为瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter most; world models are not on the critical path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩下编排与算力最重要，世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

episodes.tEn: Inside China's AI Labs: Nathan Lambert on Open Models, Compute Constraints, and US-China Divergence
Open Models as the Engine for the Next Decade of AI Research
AI State of the Art: DeepSeek, Claude Opus 4.5, and the Global Race
AI2 Launches Fully Open Almo 3 Models, Challenging Closed-Source AI
Post-Training Recipes and RLVR with Nathan Lambert
Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by far.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远比算法选择重要，SFT 贡献九成性能。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，同时警告过优化问题，并称推理时 Scaling 曲线是一种“障眼法”。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理 Scaling。

views.en: Open models become the engine of AI research for a decade, yet lag frontier models 6-9 months and may be unsustainable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但承认其落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，且长期商业模式不可持续。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

episodes.tEn: Alexander Wang on Founding Scale at 19
Meta's AI Journey: From Llama 4 to Muse Spark and Beyond
Alex Wang on Meta's AI Strategy and New Model Release
AI's Acceleration: From Pre-training to Recursive Self-Improvement
Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单纯堆算力不会产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与用于后训练的人类专家供给，企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并主张对华芯片出口管制。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，AI 是中心化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data and RL; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without mitigation; model welfare matters.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地扩展；未经缓解就开源强大模型不安全，Meta 因此从完全开源转向选择性发布，并认为模型福利值得道德考量。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Opus 5: Unstoppable Performance and Prompt Injection Immunity
Claude Code: The Future of AI Agents and Software Engineering
Claude Tag: Proactive AI That Remembers and Acts Autonomously
AI Coding on Phone: Boris on 8B Tokens & ROI
The Origin of Claude Code: From Accident to Agent
Will AI Replace Software Engineers?
Claude Code's Explosive Growth and the Future of AI Agents
Claude Code: The Accidental Revolution in Software Development
From Pokémon Cards to AI: The Claude Code Story
Claude Code: The End of Software Engineering as We Know It
Building for the Model 6 Months from Now: The Accidental Creation of Claude Code
Boris Cherny: From Meta to Claude Code, Building Products with Generalists

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
views.zh: 在 2025 年，Boris Cherny 强调潜在需求是产品第一原则，要为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建，AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product, design, and code.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为编程已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将演变为融合产品、设计与代码的'构建者'角色。

views.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction layer; tool use and autonomous workflows drive exponential productivity gains.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体与循环是继智能体之后的新抽象层，工具使用与自主工作流带来指数级生产力提升。

views.en: Safety and alignment are core to product development; releasing early in the wild helps study real-world model behavior.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全与对齐是产品开发的核心，尽早发布有助于研究模型在真实世界中的行为。

views.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete most system prompts and code, and let models self-verify through empirical iteration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：对前沿模型而言更少指令更好，应删除大部分系统提示与代码，让模型通过经验迭代自我验证。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变得廉价，决定做什么的产品品味成为最重要的技能。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with Claude Tag landing 65% of product PRs.
views.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaced hand-holding.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束；随着模型判断力取代手把手引导，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

views.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is fine; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop.
views.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有强大的测试套件，重写就没问题；外层代码审查可以不再需要人类。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI is the unifying mission enabling fast cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的留存与打磨内部标准，为每个功能把关；安全 AGI 是统一使命，支撑快速的跨组织决策。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的核心是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格文档；模型越聪明，提示词越应精简、指令越少。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity, spending context and compute upfront.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，前期就花掉上下文窗口与算力。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; CLAUDE.md may go away, and per-model context files overconstrain as frontier models become Pareto dominant.
views.zh: 提示工程是元技能；CLAUDE.md 可能消失，按模型维护上下文文件会过度约束，前沿模型将走向帕累托占优。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must understand.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型发展定速是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, one-on-ones, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初：以吃自己的狗粮、一对一沟通和使命对齐来领导；作战室需要现实的时间预期以保护团队士气。

views.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化。

views.en: Same period: code is the source of truth, design docs give way to PRs, and AI-assisted reviews rewrite team norms.
views.zh: 同一时期：代码是唯一事实来源，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助评审重写团队规范。

views.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill outdated processes.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平化，并砍掉过时流程。

views.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证和即时规划最为关键。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型，推理时算力（思考）成为新的扩展轴。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具，能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they require exponentially more compute, and post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍强调 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的肌肉，投入探索的算力多于训练最终产物。

views.en: Talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta's dollars; alignment risks like scheming will dominate as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为人才密度与使命信念比跟 Meta 拼钱更重要；随着模型能力增强，模型阴谋等对齐风险将在未来一两年成为关键。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他眼中最大的进展是自动化科研，并给出具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: AI now solves many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency, and capabilities remain jagged.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向数学：AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，能力依然参差不齐。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域有效，却难应对主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

views.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to acting as a meta-community builder enabling the broader open source ecosystem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库，转向作为元社区建设者去赋能更广泛的开源生态。

views.en: Open source keeps winning on cost and control; China championing open models and humanoids not being the final form are surprising but plausible.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出，并认为中国成为开源 AI 旗手、人形机器人未必是终极形态都出人意料却合理。

views.en: Openness and safety are orthogonal: alignment, not open vs closed, is the real security layer as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的安全层是对齐，沙箱与护栏在模型变强后并不足够。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science to avoid regulatory capture.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向警示：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，而有意放缓发展需要开放科学来避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster rather than replacing them.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据（如 PDB），而非单纯的数据与算力堆砌；AI 工具让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust as society learns to navigate it.
views.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立用户对 AI 预测信任的关键；信任会像互联网信任一样，随社会逐渐学会驾驭而自然形成。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling alone, drove its leap; it is the opposite of the bitter lesson.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AlphaFold 2 的飞跃源于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），它恰恰是“苦涩教训”的反例。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding stays with humans.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他不断深化这一立场：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；理解仍属于人类，模型只提供预测与控制。

views.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线讲得更透：进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和“十次错九次”的试错，而非孤独天才式的一两次突破。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
views.zh: 预训练带来广度，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

views.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, so less compute may suffice.
views.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型比肩更大的模型，因此更少的算力或许就够用。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
views.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越它，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

views.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
views.zh: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可能损害 pass@k，即便 best-of-n 提升；强化学习需要精心工程才能胜过监督微调。

views.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
views.zh: 拥有多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可以胜过更大的模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
views.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
views.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样学习。

views.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity matters.
views.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容至关重要。

views.en: The goal is AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge.
views.zh: 目标是让 AI 增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain open.
views.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，解决方案仍是开放问题。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的核心，主张用好奇心驱动、无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习来弥合差距。

views.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires dynamic action spaces and cross-robot generalization; modular motor policies enable zero-shot transfer to novel morphologies.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要动态动作空间和跨机器人泛化，模块化运动策略可实现对新形态的零样本迁移。

views.en: Sim-to-real transfer often relies on hidden engineering; auto-tuning simulators and 2D manifold reasoning are more efficient than volumetric 3D for robotics.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为仿真到现实的迁移常依赖隐藏工程，自动调优仿真器和 2D 流形推理比体积 3D 表示更高效。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data can power any robot.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，一个在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and requires rigorous testing and a data flywheel.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为部署是首要技术挑战而非仅商业问题，机器人无法像软件一样扩张，需要严格测试和数据飞轮。
